caption: The drawing depicts a single, elongated white or off-white textile object, likely a stocking or sleeve, set against a plain, light beige background. The textile is decorated with a series of embroidered floral patterns. Near the top, there are two pink flowers with green leaves, positioned on either side. Below them, in the center, is a single blue flower with green leaves. A few inches further down, there is a band or seam crossing horizontally. Below this band, there are more embroidered floral designs consisting of several pink flowers with green leaves, some of which have open blooms and buds. The object itself appears to have a slight curve and is rendered with attention to textile details such as ribbing or stitching along the borders and seams. The overall composition centers the embroidered textile on the neutral background, with no other objects present in the image.
